facts.fact: UNESCO describes ninth-century foundations and a thirteenth/fourteenth-century Marinid high point; the historic urban fabric includes madrasas, fondouks, mosques and craft traditions.

facts.fact: The Medina of Fez was inscribed on the World Heritage List in 1981. This is the medina designation, not a separate 1916 UNESCO inscription for Nejjarine.

notes: UNESCO identification and English/Spanish descriptions read, together with the inscription field and historical urban synthesis. No promise that every building is medieval or every street is free of vehicles is inferred.
